verdict.rationale: Gunderson's public service pages (early-stage company, financing, executive comp) include some plain-language explainer content, e.g. describing SAFEs/convertible notes and formation basics, which loosely serves a founder-education function. However, there's no evidence of a structured public knowledge base, dedicated FAQ section, or guide library — the closest thing (Catalyze's Knowledge Hub) is explicitly client-exclusive, not public. Missing for 10: dedicated FAQ/guide pages, an openly accessible knowledge hub, and explicit equity-education content beyond marketing-style service descriptions.
